Pentium P54C 165 MHz with no MMX (avp.exe needs MMX). The gate also has an operator override: not wanted on .243

summary: FAIL on all 7 applicable XP boxes, all from one library defect: the staged tree is the raw disc files, still InstallShield-obfuscated, so avp.exe asserts at alt_tab.cpp:198 before its menu. .124 is BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only). .186 and .243 are NA. No box reached the front end, so there was no multiplayer game.
issues: Library defect: the AliensVsPredator tree is the disc extract. ffinfo.txt is obfuscated, and 11 logs across 7 boxes all show 0 Loaded FastFile plus the pSurface assertion.
Even once the library is fixed, multiplayer is a DirectPlay peer game hosted from a relative-mouse menu, so it probably needs a person.
Every earlier close had to force avp.exe, because the window ignores WM_CLOSE. Boxes are now at their desktops with the agent or retro_chat console in front.
library_fix_needed: Install AvP Gold in the XP build VM, capture the installed tree, and stage it with stage-new-title.py or libwrite, keeping launch.txt, install.reg and the icons. Alternatively, decode the 154 obfuscated files with b[i]=ror8(b[i]^0xD5,2)-(i mod 0x47), with i reset for each file. Then purge and GAMESYNC. Pass = LOGFILE.TXT shows 'Loaded FastFile:' and no ASSERTION.
